capabilities: Search and insert Idealogs article links via a [[@ trigger
Render Idealogs articles in a side panel with citation markers and annotated mode
Create local comments and notes anchored to article text ranges
Sync local annotations to the Idealogs website for private viewing
Auto-download linked articles and trash them after a configurable delay
extras: Annotations synced to Idealogs are stored only in the syncing browser's localStorage, never on Idealogs servers, and must be re-synced per browser.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse, link, download, or privately annotate articles hosted on the Idealogs platform.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian companion for the Idealogs platform.

summary: Integration with the Idealogs platform that lets you search, link, view, and annotate Idealogs articles from your vault and push annotations back to the site.
